description: Assign a team member (moderator) to a conversation, or remove them from it. Pass action=assign or action=unassign to say which; without action the call toggles (adds if absent, removes if present). The assigned member is notified. To move many conversations from one member to another at once, use reassign_conversations.

action.description: assign: add the member (no change if already assigned). unassign: remove them (no change if not assigned). toggle (default): flip.

user_id.description: ID of the moderator/user to assign/remove

name: assign_moderator
